title: Burning Eye Airship
description: A massive surreal hot air balloon shaped like a melting monstrous face with one large realistic eye and jagged mouth dominates the scene. It is engulfed in bright orange flames and dripping molten material while floating beside an ornate classical building under a dark starry sky, with smaller flying saucers nearby.
prompt: A colossal surreal hot air balloon designed as a monstrous melting face with one giant realistic eye and jagged open mouth, dripping burning lava-like material and engulfed in flames, floating next to an ornate classical building facade, several smaller metallic flying saucers nearby, dramatic orange beam of light cutting through a dark starry night sky, highly detailed digital painting in a surreal fantasy style
